questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Paragonimus spp.?
options: Eggs in sputum or swallowed eggs in stool; specimen origin must accompany image labels.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Eggs in sputum or swallowed eggs in stool; specimen origin must accompany image labels. Microscopy of sputum and stool at 100–400×; serology can assist when eggs are absent.
